mandatory_origin_confinement: optibrain-command-center-v1 AppArmor: existing journal plus its three exact SQLite sidecars only; no other sibling writes

rules.description: Never cache private OptiBrain app responses

dynamic_values.CREATED_ACCESS_AUD: Only the aud returned for the newly created app with exact approved owner policy; verify with independent GET before use.
dynamic_values.CREATED_TUNNEL_UUID: Only the id returned for the newly created named tunnel on the NEW VPS; verify with independent GET before use.

ordering: Revalidate exact source, policy hashes, absence of app DNS/tunnel, current owner identity and zero incremental cost; halt on drift.
Install exact source/runtime, pinned cloudflared binary and local origin TLS; no public route and no enabled tunnel yet.
Create the separate Access app with the exact inline owner policy; verify API readback including no bypass or service-token policy.
Render only the two provider-assigned identifiers; seal resolved files and exact owner rollout authorization. Verify production origin denies all requests without the correct signed human JWT.

Create/verify the exact hostname-only cache bypass and HTTPS redirect; leave the existing zone-wide HTTPS setting unchanged. Verify Access enforcement before any external route. If a protected edge test cannot establish enforcement, stop before DNS.
Create the named local tunnel; validate ingress and origin TLS/JWT requirements. Store its secret only through root-owned systemd credentials; start only the approved app/tunnel units.

Create only the exact proxied app CNAME after protection verification. Verify independent unauthenticated client denial, owner Google sign-in, session/logout, all app routes and unchanged production health.
On any failure remove only the exact new app route first, stop only these new units and preserve all data and approval evidence. Never weaken Access to repair login.
